name: gemini-media-mcp
description: Generate images (Nano Banana), video (Veo, Gemini Omni), speech (Gemini TTS) and music (Lyria) with Google's generative media models, with cost estimates and spend budgets.

settings.name: Gemini API key
settings.description: Key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey (stored in your keychain). Gemini CLI does not pass your shell's GEMINI_API_KEY to extensions, so set it here - or leave empty and use Vertex AI or `gemini-media-mcp configure --api-key-stdin`.

settings.name: Google Cloud project
settings.description: Optional. Vertex AI project ID; uses gcloud application-default credentials instead of an API key.

settings.name: Output directory
settings.description: Optional. Where generated media is saved (default: ~/generated_media).
